name: read_file
description: Read the contents of one or more text files from the workspace. Use when you need to see what is actually in a file before answering about it or editing it. Pass several paths at once rather than calling this repeatedly.

path.description: One path, or an array of them, relative to the workspace root (e.g. "src/app.py"). Absolute paths are accepted but must still resolve inside the workspace root. Every path is checked before anything is returned, so one bad path fails the whole call rather than returning part of the answer.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return per file. A file longer than this is truncated and says so. Raise it only when a read was cut off and the rest is actually needed.

output_schema.description: The number of files asked for decides the shape, not whether an array was used. One file: its contents verbatim, and nothing else. Several: each preceded by a "==> <path> <==" line and separated by a blank line. A file longer than max_lines is followed by a "[read_file] ... truncated: showing N of M lines..." notice.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is missing or the wrong type)
exit_codes.3: not found (one of the paths does not exist)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (a path resolves outside the workspace root, is not a regular file, or is not readable)
